title: GLP-1 drugs and addiction
line: whether the reward-pathway signal behind semaglutide shows up in trials and safety reports
question: Semaglutide acts on GLP-1 receptors in the brain's reward circuitry as well as the gut. Does the signal for alcohol and other substance use hold up across the trials now registered and in the FDA's adverse-event reports?
